rule: ruling:sam-2026-10-07 claims 5, 6 and 11: the prototype wins by default and only a DR1 judgement on the same difference or a real constraint the prototype cannot express overrides it; here DR1 (inc-136) agrees with Design Release 2.1, and EUDPA-310 is a product choice recorded in the frontend, not a persistence, validation, authentication or cross-service constraint, because leaving one option out of the select breaks nothing in the GBN-AG codelist or the backend.
outcome: The documents page stops offering 'Health certificate': the document type select offers, in order, Intra Trade Animal Health Certificate (ITAHC), Veterinary health certificate, Air waybill, Import permit, Letter of authority (Directive 2008/61/EC), Commercial invoice, Sea waybill, Rail waybill, Bill of lading, Catch certificate, Laboratory sampling results for aflatoxin (Reg 2019/1793), Journey log, Other, matching Design Release 2.1 and the DR1 judgement in inc-136. The prototype wins by default, DR1 judged the same difference the same way, and EUDPA-310's re-offer is a choice the frontend made, not a constraint the prototype cannot express. The change is to the frontend's options (and the fit and E2E specs that assert fourteen); the backend's DocumentType enum keeps HEALTH_CERTIFICATE so documents already saved with it still load and are still coded on the outbound event.
